data.heading: 1. Rabi Season harvest and Summer Season Sowing Status:
data.text:
-  As on April 10, 2026, the area sown under summer crops is 64.10 lakh ha as compared to 63.33 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.  Of this, area of 30.59 lakh ha has been sown under Rice this year.
-  As on 27.03.2026, 32.26% of area has been harvested for Rabi crops all over India. Approximately 67% area  of  Pulses  mainly  in  Gram  (66%),  Urdbean  (86%)  &  Moong  (63%);  71.56%  area  of  Oilseeds majorly in Rapeseed & Mustard (75.53%); 38.31% area of Shri Anna cum Coarse Cereals majorly in Jowar (54.47%), 25.57% area of Rice and 6.00% area of Wheat  has been harvested for Rabi crops 2025-26.

data.heading: Week 1 (10 April - 16 April 2026):
data.text: -  Overall,  Day  temperatures  are  likely  to  remain  below  normal  to  near  normal  over  most  part  of northwest, central & east India during next 2-3 days and gradually become above normal thereafter.

data.heading: Week 2 (10 April - 16 April 2026):
data.text:
-  Low to moderate Probability of Heat Wave conditions likely during the week 2 over some parts of Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, & north Coastal Andhra Pradesh. Appreciably above normal (+3.1 to +5.0°C) maximum temperatures are likely over some parts of Odisha, north Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Jharkhand, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Gangetic West Bengal and East Uttar Pradesh; normal to above-normal  maximum  temperatures  ((+1.6  to  +3.0°C)  are  likely  over  most  parts  of  Northwest India,  and  many  parts  of  the  East  &  Northeast,  South  and  Western  parts  of  India.  Below-normal weekly maximum temperatures are likely in isolated places over the rest of the country.
-  No warm night conditions are likely during the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice : About 30.59 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 32.30 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses :  About 11.54 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 10.71 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds :  About 8.31 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 7.62 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
